四级汇总词汇 · 06英文原文

The Passport in the Blue Case

蓝色箱子里的护照 · 644 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A youth orchestra booked an international charter for a concert across the border. The reservation listed every passenger, but a clerk had made a mistake in one passport number. At customs a young violinist named Omar learned that the number on his itinerary belonged to another applicant. His visa was valid, yet he could not get clearance to board until a supervisor checked the record. The others left their baggage at the counter. Omar's teacher asked the airline to hold his suitcase while they found the right document.

2An inspector requested the original declaration. A photograph did not specify who entered the number. A hotel receptionist sent the accommodation booking with Omar's full name and the check-in date. Immigration would not grant clearance on a reservation alone. A registrar told him to await an independent reply from the embassy. The teacher asked whether a lawful exception was permissible. A supervisor said a permit could be corrected without interference. Strict limits concerning a missing passport still applied.

3The embassy's clerk said an official could issue a formal note. She would need consent to transmit a passport detail and restrict access to the fax. Omar did not want a private number to be published on a public form. He signed a short request authorizing the clerk to send it specifically to the inspector. The clerk added a copy of the ministry's applicable rule. It allowed an applicant to correct a typing mistake before boarding. It did not excuse an illegal entry or any other violation.

4A strict note on enforcement made the teacher nervous. He asked whether a diplomatic intermediary could intervene. The clerk said a personal request from an ambassador would not grant immunity. Omar could simply cooperate with the inspection and ask for clarification. A restrictive rule could discourage careless bookings. It did not prohibit a correction.

5Meanwhile an airline employee noticed a blue carry-on near the loading gate. A label gave Omar's name. The employee was about to put it with the other luggage when the teacher saw that it had a second tag from a passenger bound for another port. He asked the employee to halt the transfer. The inspector checked who had last had possession of the case. A second traveler had taken the wrong bag after a security check. The confusion explained why Omar's original passport was no longer in his pocket.

6The traveler returned the case and apologized. His name was on the other tag, so an inspector could verify his identity. There was no sign of hiding documents, bribery, or a scheme to violate the rules. The officer released both cases without imposing a penalty. He put the incident on a report concerning possession of a bag, not trafficking. Omar was wary when a stranger asked to photograph the report. The officer explained the need for secrecy and sent the public an account with private details removed.

7The airline had to reschedule the connection from Wednesday to Thursday. A resort offered an exclusive room at a prohibitive price. Omar booked a modest airport hotel instead and negotiated a refund for the seat. The receptionist waived a fee after receiving a memorandum. The school retained its obligation to supervise him. His teacher remained overnight, coordinated a rehearsal, and asked whether the airline could finalize the ticket before breakfast. Omar wanted assurance that the next booking actually used the corrected number.

8They arrived during the last practice. The resumption of rehearsal let Omar join the final passage. Before the return journey, he compared the identification on his passport and ticket. A tourist asked how to orient a case on the belt. Omar pointed to his label. The officer had enforced a rule on document seizure, yet it did not forbid a traveler to inquire about a correction. Omar showed the new clerk which mistake could interfere with another boarding check.

四级汇总词汇 · 06中文译文

蓝色箱子里的护照

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一支少年管弦乐团包机出国演出。订位单列着每位乘客，却有一处护照号码填错了。年轻的小提琴手奥马尔到了海关才知道，行程单上的号码属于另一个申请人。他的签证有效，可得等主管查过记录，才能获准登机。队友把行李放到柜台。老师请航空公司先保管他的箱子，他们去找正确的文件。

2检查员要看原始申报单。老师的手机照片看不出是谁填的号码。酒店接待员发来住宿预订，上面写着奥马尔的全名和入住日期。边检不会单凭预订放行。登记员请他等使馆独立答复。老师问，能否按规定作例外处理。主管说，可以在航站楼内更正许可，过程不会受到干预。护照遗失仍有严格限制。

3使馆职员说，相关人员可以出具正式说明。发送护照信息需要本人同意，传真也要限制谁能看。奥马尔不愿让私人号码出现在公开表格上。他签了申请，授权职员只发给那名检查员。使馆附上主管部门的适用规定，申请人登机前可以纠正录入错误，非法入境或其他违规行为仍要按规定处理。

4一条严格的执法说明让老师有些紧张。他问能不能请外交中间人出面。职员说，就算大使亲自请求，也不会产生豁免。奥马尔只需要配合检查，要求把规则说清楚。限制性规定可以避免粗心订票，遇到录入错误时仍可更正。

5这时，航空公司员工在装运行李的门边发现一个蓝色随身箱。标签上写着奥马尔。员工正要把它和其他行李放到一起，老师看见另一个标签，属于去另一处港口的乘客。他请员工暂停转运。检查员查最后是谁拿过箱子。原来，另一位旅客过安检后拿错了。这也解释了奥马尔的护照原件为什么不在自己的口袋里。

6旅客还回箱子并道歉。另一个标签有他的名字，检查员可以核实身份。没有迹象表明他藏了文件、行贿或蓄意违规。检查员没有处罚，放行了两只箱子，报告里记的是误拿行李的经过，没有定性为走私。一个陌生人想拍报告，奥马尔提高了警惕。检查员解释了保密要求，公开说明里删去了私人细节。

7航空公司只能把周三的转机改到周四。一家度假酒店提供独用客房，价格高得难以接受。奥马尔订了机场旁一家简朴酒店，和航空公司商量退掉原来的座位。接待员收到备忘后免去一项费用。学校仍有照管义务，老师陪他住了一夜，协调排练，还问能不能在早饭前定下机票。奥马尔希望下一张订单确实用了改正后的号码。

8两人赶上了最后一次练习。短暂停歇后，排练恢复，奥马尔得以加入最后一段。返程前，他对照护照和票上的身份信息。一位旅客问怎么把箱子摆上传送带。奥马尔指给他看自己的标签。检查员依据的是有关扣留文件的规则，旅客仍可以询问如何改正信息。奥马尔把那个曾妨碍登机检查的错误指给新职员看。
